'''Rolan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the apprentice of [[Darth Thanaton]]. He engaged [[Darth Zash]]'s former apprentice, Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], in Thanaton's Meditation Chamber but he was killed in the ensuing conflict.
